title: Xanthe and the Confession
author: Xanthe Blackwood
blurb: Petra Dunmore, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
